subject: gk
question: In which of the following years was the Muslim League formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1906**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The All-India Muslim League (AIML) **was founded in** Dhaka in 1906** by notable **Muslim politicians **who met with **Lord Minto, the Viceroy of British India**, to safeguard Muslim interests on the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Emerging due to the necessity for Muslim representation in British India, particularly amidst Hindu opposition following the 1905 partition of Bengal, the AIML played a crucial role.
 
• After India's Partition and the creation of Pakistan, the AIML formally disbanded within India.
 
• It was succeeded by the Pakistan Muslim League, which later fragmented. In Bangladesh, attempts to revive the Muslim League occurred in 1976, but with reduced influence. 
 
• In India, a distinct and autonomous entity known as the Indian Union Muslim League was established, and it maintains representation in the Indian parliament up to the present day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• During the 1906 annual meeting of the All India Muslim Education Conference at Israt Manzil Palace, Dhaka, the Nawab of Dhaka, Khwaja Salimullah, proposed the creation of a political party to safeguard the interests of Muslims in British India.
 
• Sir Mian Muhammad Shafi, a prominent Muslim leader from Lahore, suggested naming the party the 'All-India Muslim League'.
 
• The proposal was unanimously accepted, leading to the formal establishment of the All-India Muslim League in Dhaka.
 
• Initially, the League primarily catered to the elite, but by 1937, its leadership began mobilizing the Muslim masses, transforming it into a popular organization.
